name: One-Eyed Lee: Prologue
source:
"Every night, without fail, I dreamt of what was beyond my family's wheatfield. The whole world was waiting for me, just beyond that horizon; a whole world I had never seen before. At the time, my only true desire in this world was to see what was beyond that wheatfield..."

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/one-eyed-lee-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“每天晚上，我都会梦到我家麦田之外的东西。整个世界都在等着我，就在地平线之外；一个我以前从未见过的世界。当时，我在这个世界上唯一真正的愿望就是看看麦田之外有什么……”

[来自[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/one-eyed-lee-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
